name: aitmpl
description: Claude Code plugins listed on aitmpl.com, each pinned to the commit that was reviewed and scanned.

plugins.name: champion-kit
plugins.description: Help Claude Code champions run hackathons and office hours, find patterns worth sharing, help teammates climb the steps of AI adoption, and write a maturity report.

plugins.name: egm
plugins.description: Draft specs, review designs, and check implementation drift.

plugins.name: prompt-cache-control
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter above the Claude Code prompt: how many tokens each request read from, wrote to and sent past the cache, a live countdown to the cache's expiry, and what to do about it (keep going, compact or clear). The TTL follows Claude Code's own rules for your account (1 hour on a Claude subscription, 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits, plus the TTL variables and setting) and corrects itself from request timing. When Claude Code will compact an idle conversation by itself, it counts down to that too. /cache opens a per-turn table.

plugins.name: stack-viewer
plugins.description: A side pane that maps every component your session runs and where it is installed from: skills, subagents, commands, hooks, MCP servers, plugins and mods, settings, memory and output styles. Pick a type in the sidebar to see its scopes as a tree in precedence order (Enterprise, CLI flag, Local, Project, User, Plugin, Built-in) with what each one holds, and which components are active, shadowed by a higher scope, or off.
